description: Can add members to a group - dangerous when the group is role-assignable or grants access.

telemetry.detail: Entra ID audit log: 'Add member to group' (directory logging is default-on).
Addition to a privileged/role-assignable group may be flagged by anomaly policies.

prerequisite_privilege: Owner of the group, or a role permitting group membership changes
abuse_primitive: Add a controlled principal to a role-assignable or access-granting group.
notes: Group membership change is audited; noise rises when the group is privileged.
